name: decision_receipt
description: Record and recover a source-versioned decision for an exact tool call. For a gated call: snapshot the source, narrowly re-read it and verify the selection, write the receipt against that same fingerprint, then retry with decision_receipt_id. Freshness checks the source version, not whether the model's reasoning was correct.

target_args.description: Exact planned dispatch arguments, without decision_receipt_id. For snapshot of a tool-derived source, start with the intended target arguments.

source_path.description: Source data file, relative to the effective cwd, for snapshot/write. Omit when the registered target tool derives its own source paths.

source_fingerprint.description: Required for write: the fingerprint from snapshot obtained before re-reading the source.

kind.description: Required for write: an ASCII identifier for the decision, e.g. ranked_selection.

numeric_params.description: Integer decision parameters, e.g. sort_direction (-1, 0, 1), tie_rule code and limit.

selected_ids.description: Selected IDs in decision order, preserved exactly.

id.description: With list, recover this exact receipt, including its recorded decision and current freshness.

before.description: With list, page backward using the last receipt ID from the previous page.
